name: Misachi
source:
Classmate of [url=/c89999]Kuzumi[/url] at Rindoukan Academy.
She is a Gyaru who belongs to the same group as [url=/c89918]Osanami Youka[/url].
She is extremely whimsical and does not want to be bound by others. She often leaves school together with Youka.
